deletionTournament.deletionEffect: Deleting owner/actor scope moves authority and evaluation across project boundaries and changes which facts can authorize action.
Deleting identity conflates ticker/economic identity, reviewed bytes/source revision, or exact Security target/environment.
Without a named claim/transition, evidence for liquidity, legibility, bounded no-effect or population mechanism can be laundered into unrelated conclusions.
Owner/source evidence determines who may author a fact; normalized labels or transported observations cannot self-authorize.
Deleting structured epistemic status turns missing/stale evidence into negative truth and changes admission/recovery.

deletionTournament.distinction: historical time vs current applicability / known_at
deletionTournament.deletionEffect: Deleting temporal separation leaks later evidence backward or rewrites historical truth.
QUALIFIED/proposal-ready/rendered/capable never automatically means authorized/submitted/published.
Network/materialization failure changes current actionability without rewriting carrier/source/history truth.

deletionTournament.distinction: Resource vs ActionableResource vs Option separation
deletionTournament.deletionEffect: A discovered/qualified possibility may still be non-actionable or not worth selecting; collapsing them changes acquisition/experiment admission.
All five owners make real decisions from conjunctive gates; deleting conjunction changes feasibility/admission.
Useful where exact components/resources are assigned to a transition, but owner-native reducers/manifests already own it.
Quantities change actual action when minimum notional/leverage, Zone/concurrency/latency, or review burden bind; units and owners differ.

deletionTournament.distinction: substitution/redundancy independence relative to failure class
deletionTournament.deletionEffect: Duplicate keys or shared evidence/provider roots do not add independent capacity/redundancy; disturbance class matters.

deletionTournament.distinction: Action identity separate from physical/mechanical Effect
deletionTournament.deletionEffect: Proposal/commit/attempt can exist without the intended effect; effect uncertainty/recovery changes next action.
Operational model behavior/render/process effects do not establish alpha, player value, publication, causal harmlessness or retained Human capability.
Observed favorable/unfavorable outcomes do not prove Agent/treatment causality without comparison/mechanism evidence.
One review/trial/receipt does not automatically become product law, taste authority or reusable general knowledge.
Failures/UNKNOWN/rejected axes alter ranking, block promotion or narrow hypotheses; deleting them creates false optimism and repeated work.
Empty ledger/null observation or no-secondary-effects claim is only bounded by what was actually observable.
External evidence can generate a hypothesis/prior without becoming target truth; direct target experiment only when residual matters.
Clear reversible defects are fixed with less evidence; consequential unresolved Human claims justify residual evidence only when decision-relevant.

deletionTournament.distinction: owner-native state machine vs cross-owner projection
deletionTournament.deletionEffect: Each domain already owns state transitions; a global Resource state would overwrite native authority and currentness semantics.
No dogfood decision needs one lifecycle axis; native states and projections already decide correctly.
Conjunctive semantics repeat, but no owner reproduces a missing shared executor; global graph would duplicate local admission/reducers.
Capacity matters but quantity kind, unit, time window, owner and consequences differ; local semantics already exist.
All owners preserve structured evidence/claims locally and reject scalar laundering; no repeated missing shared belief authority.
Transport assessment is useful when source→target questions exist, but direct local evidence does not need every target/moderator/VOI field.
Outcome semantics are domain-owned and heterogeneous; common terminology does not create shared executable responsibility.
Hard gates, plural outcomes and structured unknowns repeatedly outrank scalar ranking.
Owners explicitly reject it absent repeated responsibility above owner boundaries.
Real owners persist native observations/claims/state and derive decisions; none requires World to persist one cross-owner Resource record as current authority.
Capabilities are owner/boundary-relative supported abilities or exported relations; each domain can consume them without a global lifecycle/manager, and authority never transfers with the label.
